The scope builder in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py` (`heal_scope_guard_subjects`, around lines 4350-4372) adds `docs/INVENTORY.md` only when the workflow size guard fails, not for `tests/inventory_parity.py`. Option C is unsupported: GITHUB FACTS do not show that #9510 adds the entries, and #9401 targets `orchestrator/project-9394`, so it could never fix `main`. Option A is the only choice whose premise holds, and it needs no outside data: both scripts exist in the checkout, `docs/INVENTORY.md` still has no `review_final_ci` entry (only `scripts/review_freshness_ci_failed.sh` at line 304), and the bullet text is already in the issue's "Suggested fix". The plan must name the exact edit: two bullets for `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh` and `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh` next to line 304 of `docs/INVENTORY.md`, plus an optional `changelog.d/9578-*.md` fragment. It must not touch `tests/inventory_parity.py`, and it must state that the `test_prepush_affected_tests.py` half is already fixed on `main`. The plan must not include steps to close this issue, open another issue or PR, or post comments. Because the plan names a file outside the frozen scope, the existing `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope` hold in `plan.yml` will stop it and send it to a maintainer, who applies the fix outside the heal pipeline. That is option A.
